prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: 1024x1024 marketplace plugin icon
Purpose: a premium public icon for official-source-first Poland support used by residents, immigrants, expats, and citizens with AI agents.
Literal semantic hero: one bold simplified silhouette of the geographic shape of Poland, filled as the Polish flag with a clean horizontal white upper field and saturated crimson lower field. Preserve Poland's recognizable outer contour while simplifying tiny border details for 16px clarity. It must be one solid centered mass.
Support cue: exactly one compact four-node circuit spark cut into the lower crimson field near the center, integrated into the map silhouette and clearly subordinate. The cue signals helpful AI technology, not sharing.
Composition: one centered dominant silhouette, full-bleed opaque deep wine-red square background, generous padding, meaningful content inside the central 68 percent, no second object.
Style: original premium vector-like product mark, flat bold filled geometry, crisp edges, balanced negative space, subtle restrained depth only at the map edge; modern civic technology, friendly and high-trust.
Small-size requirement: the Poland silhouette and white-over-red flag split stay recognizable at 64, 32, 24, and 16 pixels; the circuit spark may simplify but must not fragment the hero.
Color palette: warm white, Polish crimson #D4213D, and deep wine-red background; strong contrast at thumbnail scale.
Brand source: original generated artwork using the public geographic outline and Polish national colors only; no official emblem, protected state mark, or third-party brand.
Avoid: white eagle, coat of arms, state emblem, passport, government seal, map pin, speech bubble, ribbon loop, infinity sign, chain link, share icon, robot face, brain, microchip outline, handshake, stars, text, letters, numbers, people, UI screenshot, photorealism, glossy 3D, decorative pattern, thin-line illustration, object collage, excessive gradients.
Collision avoid: generic country flag tile without the Poland silhouette; ChatGPT, OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, Copilot, play, share, or any proprietary technology logo.
Text: none. No watermark.
Output intent: distinctive, fashionable, trustworthy Poland-plus-AI public product icon for a GitHub repository and a 16px plugin catalog thumbnail.
checks: save the selected image as a 1024x1024 opaque RGB PNG at assets/icon.png
inspect semantic recognition and the monochrome silhouette at 16, 24, 32, and 64 px
reject a competing second cue, closed critical gap, portfolio collision, text, screenshot, photo, watermark, or low contrast
verify brand-source, trademark, license, and authorization provenance manually
wire identical interface.composerIcon and interface.logo paths plus interface.brandColor
